_comment: Visit Pioneer Square's neighbourhood calendar (pioneersquare.org/events/). HTML only - the site publishes no iCal, no Tribe REST, no event post type and no schema.org Event JSON-LD, all verified - so mapsee_ingest_pioneersquare.py scrapes it. The pages give a venue NAME and no address or coordinates, and the sync drops anything it cannot place, so `venues` is a venue book exactly like rolodex_sources.json: street+city+region per room, which the sync geocodes. A venue missing from the book is skipped LOUDLY - watch the log for '[pioneersquare] unplaceable venue' and add it here. Addresses below were read from the site's own directory (/businesses/<slug>/ carries a 'Contact:' block); they were NOT guessed. Category is the default only - derive_categories in mapsee_supabase_sync promotes the jazz nights to music and the openings to arts from the text.

sites.name: Visit Pioneer Square
sites._venues_comment: Keyed loosely - the adapter lowercases, strips punctuation and drops a leading 'the', so 'The Shop @ LMN Architects' matches 'shop lmn architects'. An entry needs an address OR a lat/lon pair; coordinates win where a street address describes the place badly. STILL MISSING, and each logs on every run until filled in: 'Victory Hall' (no directory page; 1 event), 'Grand Central Building' (no directory page; 1), and 'B612 Gallery: Pioneer Square' (the directory has Gallery B612 at 1915 1st Ave S, which is SODO - the ':Pioneer Square' suffix suggests a second room, so it is deliberately left out rather than pinned to the wrong neighbourhood; 1).

pioneer park._comment: The Pioneer Square totem pole, on the triangle at 1st Ave & Yesler Way. Google resolves it as 'Pioneer Square Totem Pole, Seattle, WA 98104'; OSM has 'Seattle Totem Pole, 100 Yesler Way' at these coordinates. Pinned rather than geocoded because the name is a trap - a fuzzy lookup for 'Pioneer Place Park' returns three parks in Renton first.
